rationale: The app uses spinner loaders (animate-spin) that don't indicate what content is loading. Skeleton screens provide visual structure that matches the final content, making the app feel faster and preventing jarring layout shifts when content loads.
problemSolved: Products page (lines 533-535) shows a centered spinner during loading. When products load, the empty state message or product list suddenly appears. This causes a jarring visual jump and doesn't preview the upcoming content structure.
